name: TW-08 · Leads · Inbound lead hub — WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, email, website

nodes.name: Gmail · new enquiry email
nodes.notes: Shipped OFF: turn on only after testing, so the bot never auto-replies to cold sales email.

nodes.name: Read prospects
nodes.notes: Outbound campaign list. If the Prospects tab does not exist yet, this is skipped and every message is treated as a normal inbound lead.

parameters.jsCode:
const d = $('Lead engine').item.json;
return { json: { ...d, final_row: d.row, send_result: "sent", send_error: "" } };

parameters.subject: TW-08 alert: could not update the CRM sheet
parameters.message:
={{ 'The lead hub could not write to the Google Sheet.

Lead: ' + ($('Lead engine').item.json.row['Lead ID']) + ' (' + $('Lead engine').item.json.row.Name + ')
Error: ' + ($json.error ? ($json.error.message || JSON.stringify($json.error)) : 'unknown') + '

The customer was not affected; their message and the automated reply (if any) went through. Add or fix the row by hand.' }}

parameters.subject: ={{ 'TW-08 alert: automated reply failed - ' + $json.row.Name }}
parameters.message:
={{ 'An automated reply could not be sent, so the lead was NOT advanced.

Lead: ' + $json.row['Lead ID'] + '
Name: ' + $json.row.Name + '
Channel: ' + $json.row.Channel + ' via ' + $json.send.via + '
Error: ' + $json.send_error + '

Reply to the customer personally. Common causes: an expired WhatsApp/Meta token, a WhatsApp template not approved yet, or the customer chat window closed.' }}
